title: Platypus Mayhem
description:
This mod adds Platypuses to the world of Minecraft!
That's all to it really
body:
This adds in platypuses to Minecraft! You can find them near rivers or plains and you can even tame them with water beetles which you can get by fishing! 
theres a extra entity that attends raids as well.

--There's a few bugs but please don't mind them but do send them in the discord!--

Platypus model was inspired off of itisbeez's platypus model. check them out
